failure_summary.description: Agents searched instead of updating suitable cached results, selected an older base, omitted constraints, or failed to save results.
Agents added unrelated searches or retrievals, repeated completed work, or emitted unnecessary output.
Agents treated a return date as an arrival constraint instead of searching a return leg, or invented a hotel checkout date.
Agents failed to preserve the requested AM/PM in a flight-time bound or treated an exact rating as a minimum.

patch.reasoning: The recurring failures are already explicitly addressed by the learned rules: use the latest suitable cached base, save every result, avoid unrelated work, handle round trips as separate legs, do not invent hotel dates, and map exact ratings and time bounds precisely. Adding these instructions again would duplicate existing content rather than patch a skill gap.
